summary: fractal-ui Transcript accepts a host renderItem that presents chosen messages and events itself

schema.detail: No tables, columns, indexes or triggers.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Only packages/fractal-ui changes. TranscriptProps gains an optional renderItem(item) callback. When it returns a node, the kit renders that node inside the message root for the item; when it returns undefined, or the host omits the prop, the kit presentation is unchanged.
